name: tattoo-studio-platform
description: chayns-integrierte Anfrage- und Terminplattform fuer ein Tattoo-Studio

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tattoo-studio/contracts && npm run build --workspace @tattoo-studio/api && npm run build --workspace @tattoo-studio/web
scripts.check-types: npm run build --workspace @tattoo-studio/contracts && npm run check-types --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @tattoo-studio/contracts && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @tattoo-studio/api" "npm run worker --workspace @tattoo-studio/api" "npm run dev --workspace @tattoo-studio/web"
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @tattoo-studio/contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
